title: Upgrade to v1.27.0 (Divergence hardening: canonical IAVL reads + supply invariant guard)
summary: Coordinated activation of consensus-critical divergence hardening. This release completes the IAVL read-path safety work by removing remaining advisory fast-node reads from consensus paths: point reads now use canonical IAVL as authoritative source even when the fast index has a hit. It also adds a supply invariant guard at EndBlock that halts a corrupted node when recorded supply does not match sum(balances), instead of silently committing a divergent app hash. This directly addresses the recurring single-node divergence class observed on mirage.talk, including the 2026-06-12 incident where supply was undercounted by 164,124,000 due to a stale read. No on-chain state migration is required (no new params, no new store keys, no module migrations), but this is state-machine-breaking behavior and therefore must activate at one coordinated upgrade height across validators.
